verdict.rationale: Viam markets cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting and a Fleet Management tier with remote monitoring. Its fleet API mirrors the web UI for managing organizations, locations, and machines, and the machine API and GetMachineStatus expose per-machine health and status, including whether a machine is online. A Teleop-based monitoring dashboard is also documented. Missing for 10: detailed docs of a single fleet-wide dashboard view showing health and status across all machines, evidence of physical/geographic location tracking (Viam 'locations' appear to be organizational groupings), and independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet monitoring.
